audit.why: Lane difficulty is genuinely his: Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8s) converts stored damage into a heal, which out-lasts Granite Shield's 10%-max-health absorb, and Obliterate (Q, 8/7/6/5/4s) is increased against a single target — exactly the fight a melee Malphite is forced into. The 51.32% win rate over 2231 games is Malphite-positive but that lead is banked in teamfights, not in lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as purely his spike with no number attached, and the file never compares the two ultimates.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100. Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100. At rank 1 Malphite's ultimate comes back ten seconds sooner, and Realm of Death is the longest cooldown in either kit — so the correct lane rhythm is to concede while it is up and take the fight in the window after he spends it. Stating the raw numbers turns 'respect his 6' into an actual schedule.
audit.corrected: Realm of Death is 140s at rank 1 against your 130s — fight in the window after he spends it.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early told the player to 'keep minions between you so he can't E-pull you into an isolated Q', and wants.foe[0] repeats the same model.
audit.why: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in an area — it is not a line skillshot and a minion wall does not intercept it. Worse, the advice inverts the one thing minions genuinely do here: Obliterate deals increased damage when it hits a single enemy, so standing NEXT to minions is right, but because it splits the slam, not because it blocks the pull. A player following the old line stands in the wave feeling safe from a pull that is going to land anyway.
audit.corrected: Death's Grasp pulls an area, so no minion wall blocks it. Stand beside minions anyway — Obliterate only gets its bonus when it catches you alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mordekaiser's Q is called 'his Q-isolated slam' and 'his first Q-isolated slam' rather than Obliterate.
audit.why: The real name is Obliterate and the kit carries its cooldown, 8/7/6/5/4. Naming it costs no space and makes the isolation rule findable.
audit.corrected: Obliterate (Q), 8/7/6/5/4s, increased damage on a single target.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mordekaiser's derived flags list 'grounding' on Obliterate.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Obliterate is 'smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy' — no grounding, no dash denial. Per the calibration rule the description wins over the flag, so nothing about grounding was written into the matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named only Realm of Death and gave no numbers for anything.
audit.why: The two numbers that decide this lane are the ultimate differential (140 vs 130 at rank 1) and Death's Grasp at 16s rank 1 — a sixteen-second window in which his only engage is gone. Neither appeared anywhere in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Realm of Death 140/120/100 vs your 130/115/100; Death's Grasp 16/14/12/10/8.

audit.why: The existing win condition — MR over armour, teamfight rather than duel, R as peel out of the realm — is right and matches the 51.32% headline: Malphite's edge is not the 1v1 Mordekaiser wants.

edits.before: Morde is one of the few melee bruisers you don't out-stat early, because his W shield-heal lets him sustain through your Granite Shield and his Q hits harder when you're isolated. At Level 1-2 you can contest the wave since your shield eats his first slam, but the moment he hits 3 he has Q-E-W and out-grinds you. Last-hit with Seismic Shard (Q) from range, keep minions between you so he can't E-pull you into an isolated Q, and let your shield refresh — don't sit in his W heal window trading autos.
edits.after: Morde is one of the few melee bruisers you don't out-stat early, because Indestructible (W) sustains through Granite Shield and Obliterate hits harder when you are isolated. At Level 1-2 you can contest the wave since your shield eats his first slam, but the moment he hits 3 he has Q-E-W and out-grinds you. Last-hit with Seismic Shard (Q) from range, and stand beside minions so Obliterate splits its damage rather than landing the isolated bonus on you.

Level 6 is HIS spike, not yours: Realm of Death yanks you into a 1v1 and steals your armor and AP, gutting the exact stats your E and W scale off. Don't walk up without Flash or a minion wall to block his E pull, and treat your R here as an escape from his death realm, not an engage into it.
edits.after: Your W/E coming online stabilizes farming but does NOT flip this — his sustain and isolated Obliterate still win the extended fight you are built for. It is a 140s ultimate at rank 1 against your 130s, so after he burns it you own the next ten seconds — that is your window to fight, not before.

edits.after: Realm of Death (R) is his kill window: a 140s ultimate at rank 1 that drags you 1v1 and steals your armour and AP, so never step up without Flash while it is available.

notes: Death's Grasp being an area pull rather than a blockable line is the correction that changes behaviour here — the old text sent the player into the wave believing minions would save them. The minion advice survives but for the opposite reason: Obliterate's bonus only applies when it hits you alone. One thing I did NOT assert: Mordekaiser's kit file flags Obliterate as 'grounding', which contradicts Riot's description text, so no dash-denial claim was written. Chart note: the packet's levelChart for this matchup is Mordekaiser at all seven stages, while both layers currently give Malphite 'Skill' at Levels 4-5 and First item. I left the chart alone because the prose supports the Skill stages and a 51.32% win rate does not read as a seven-stage loss; if the packet chart is authoritative, phases[3].side and phases[5].side need flipping.
